info.name: SkillBite API
info.description: Run with the SkillBite Local environment. The first request assigns a new email for this run. Verification and reset tokens are not in HTTP responses. In local development the server writes backend/var/mailbox.json; copy token into verifyToken or resetToken. The automated runner injects those tokens and adminPassword. Google expects 401 until identityToken and GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID are set. password is a local test password, not a production secret.
